definitions: A Japanese diplomatic journey to the United States and Europe conducted between 1871 and 1873 by leading statesmen and scholars of the Meiji period.
The mission aimed to renegotiate the unequal treaties imposed on Japan and to gather information on Western industrial, political, military, and educational systems.
examples: The Iwakura Mission was crucial for Japan's modernization.
Members of the Iwakura Mission observed Western technologies.
The Iwakura Mission's findings influenced Meiji reforms.
